description: Source code for managing notification hints in a SQL store, including functions for inserting, updating, deleting, and fetching notification hints, as well as handling concurrency and database-specific syntax.

classes.name: SQLStore
classes.description: Struct representing the SQL storage layer, with methods for handling notification hints.

methods.name: notificationHintFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of NotificationHint models.

methods.name: upsertNotificationHint
methods.description: Creates or updates a notification hint in the database, setting notify_at based on current time and notifyFreq.

methods.name: deleteNotificationHint
methods.description: Deletes a notification hint for a specific block ID.

methods.name: getNotificationHint
methods.description: Fetches a notification hint for a specific block ID.

methods.name: getNextNotificationHint
methods.description: Retrieves the next scheduled notification hint, optionally removing it from the database.
